---
description: "Capture a lesson learned or incident postmortem in eShopOrgMeta"
agent: agent
---

Capture what we learned in this session in eShopOrgMeta `lessons-learned/`.

1. Ask whether this is a lesson (`templates/lesson-learned.md`) or an incident (`templates/postmortem.md`).
2. Summarize facts with links/evidence; blameless wording; no secrets or PII.
3. Write `lessons-learned/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md` (prefix `incident-` for postmortems).
4. Add a row to the index in `lessons-learned/README.md`.
5. If the lesson should change a standard, propose the edit and whether it needs an ADR.
